summary: Offline chain integration test without an LLM: local ticket → intake → local repo in a real sandbox → patch file + ticket comment

comments.body: [devin] PR #80 up: https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/80 — full offline chain, no LLM: real executor + real 7.1 sandbox + real wiring, scripted agent_factory. Ticket JSON -> poll -> shallow copy -> commit + jira_comment -> patch+bundle in private/runs/<run_id>/, git am applies on host; ticket moved + commented; decoy fix branch absent; Atlassian/GitHub transports patched to fail. Second case: handoff note in ticket JSON + anvil-needs-human. 2 passed in ~4 min.
